mapper.sql: SELECT us.user_selection_id, us.user_id, us.game_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, us.pattern_combo_code, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c2.title) FROM xycc_pattern_combo pc2 LEFT JOIN xycc_pattern_combo_career pcc2 ON pc2.pattern_combo_id = pcc2.combo_id LEFT JOIN xycc_career c2 ON pcc2.career_id = c2.career_id WHERE pc2.code = us.pattern_combo_code ) as career_titles, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT e2.title) FROM xycc_pattern_combo pc2 LEFT JOIN xycc_pattern_combo_env pce2 ON pc2.pattern_combo_id = pce2.combo_id LEFT JOIN xycc_work_env e2 ON pce2.env_id = e2.work_env_id WHERE pc2.code = us.pattern_combo_code ) as env_titles, us.created_at FROM xycc_user_selection us LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON us.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN xycc_pattern_combo pc ON us.pattern_combo_code = pc.code LEFT JOIN xycc_pattern_combo_career pcc ON pc.pattern_combo_id = pcc.combo_id LEFT JOIN xycc_career c ON pcc.career_id = c.career_id LEFT JOIN xycc_pattern_combo_env pce ON pc.pattern_combo_id = pce.combo_id LEFT JOIN xycc_work_env e ON pce.env_id = e.work_env_id
mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM gkzh_activity_participation_record r LEFT JOIN xycc_user_selection s ON r.module_id = s.user_selection_id WHERE r.activity_id = #{activityId} and r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
